read_convention: UTF-8 splitlines inclusive; LF joined without appended LF; raw LF and terminal LF separately recorded. PDF form-feed is a splitlines separator.
pdf_extractor:
pdftotext version 26.01.0
Copyright 2005-2026 The Poppler Developers - http://poppler.freedesktop.org
Copyright 1996-2011, 2022 Glyph & Cog, LLC
pdf_extraction: pdftotext -layout input.pdf output.txt; exact bytes frozen; no offline subprocess or visual-layout assertion
lexical_convention: Every re.finditer occurrence, repeated representations retained, zero-based codepoint offsets in each splitline; IGNORECASE; sorted fixed domains
external_scope: CNPv2 definition and Section6 proofs through ending; Craciunv3 embedding and Section8 application ending only; consensusv1 statement, uniform-window discussion, evolution Lemma14 through ending. No full external-proof audit claimed.
decoded_convention: Brief views equal the exact decoded JSON brief plus one appended LF; other views parse to all non-brief fields exactly. The appended LF is not represented as original JSON content.
